wake.text: A ceiling she doesn't know. A door hanging open. Rain.

letter.text: The handwriting is hers. She doesn't remember writing it.
If you're reading this, he got me. He took everything.
Trust Dov. You won't remember why. — R.

meet_dov.text: She steps through the open door, into the street.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: Rhea! I've been looking for you all day. Are you hurt?

meet_dov.speaker: Rhea
meet_dov.text: Anyone can read a letter and say a name.

meet_dov.speaker: Dov
meet_dov.text: Rhea, please. What did he do to you?
She draws her baton. Her hands know how, even if she doesn't.

duel_wake.text: He raises his fists. He's holding back, but not by much.

duel_parry.speaker: Dov
duel_parry.text: What else could I expect? First parry, and it's perfect.

duel_parry.speaker: Rhea
duel_parry.text: Hey. Turns out I'm pretty good at this.

duel_blast_unlock.text: Something flickers behind her eyes. Not a memory. The edge of one.

duel_nala.speaker: Nala
duel_nala.text: Nala leaps out of the rain and lands between them, fur on end.

after_duel.speaker: Nala
after_duel.text: Nala meows at Rhea, once, like a question.

after_duel.speaker: Rhea
after_duel.text: I know her. I don't know my own name, but I know hers.

after_duel.speaker: Dov
after_duel.text: You remember the cat... and not me?

after_duel.speaker: Dov
after_duel.text: No idea why you remember her. But she's never wrong about people.

after_duel.speaker: Nala
after_duel.text: Nala's fur stands on end. She hisses at the dark.
Grey raincoats in the fog. Smooth faces. No eyes.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: Rhea. My sister. My parents took you in when you were small.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: Quill is the magistrate of our ward. Years ago, he had our mother unwritten.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: Dad died fighting his men. Mom became Forgotten.

after_b1.speaker: Rhea
after_b1.text: Like the ones we just fought?

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: Nobody can hold on to them, not even for a minute. Most of them break.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: One day Mom walked out of the city. We don't know where she is.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: You became a courier. Carried Quill's letters, smiled at his clerks.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: You wanted to get close enough to kill him. Then the King.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: You trained at the Memorist School. You got strong. Too strong.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: The King signed a warrant to unwrite you. Quill cast it. It backfired.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: People started forgetting him. So he hit you with everything he had.

after_b1.speaker: Rhea
after_b1.text: And instead of the world forgetting me... I forgot the world.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: I already lost Mom and Dad. I'm not losing you twice.
Rhea doesn't remember how to hold her brother. She does it anyway.

after_b1.speaker: Dov
after_b1.text: Memorists write down everything they take. It's all in his Ledger.

after_b1.speaker: Rhea
after_b1.text: Then we pay the magistrate a visit.

after_b1_go.speaker: Rhea
after_b1_go.text: Will you finally tell me what's going on?

after_b1_go.speaker: Dov
after_b1_go.text: Not here. Let's go somewhere quieter.
Nala is already walking. They follow.

after_rest.speaker: Rhea
after_rest.text: The Ledger. If my page is in it, I want it back.

after_rest.speaker: Dov
after_rest.text: Quill keeps it in the Records Office. Past the old gate.

approach_b2.speaker: Nala
approach_b2.text: Nala stops dead. Her fur rises.

after_b2.speaker: Dov
after_b2.text: Because he knows we're coming. Move.

b2_start.text: Behind the Forgotten, grey dust gathers into something with claws.

b2_start.speaker: Dov
b2_start.text: A Hollow. Watch Nala. She feels them before they strike.

b2_immune.speaker: Dov
b2_immune.text: Hollows are made of Echo. Steel won't touch them. Only Echo will.

b2_immune.speaker: Dov
b2_immune.text: You don't have much left to burn. Make it count.

before_gate.text: The Records Office. Two shapes of dust guard the door. One is twice the size of the other.

before_gate.speaker: Dov
before_gate.text: Quill's watchdogs. The big one drinks Echo, and heals on it.

before_gate.speaker: Rhea
before_gate.text: Then we don't let it drink.

records_office.text: Shelves to the ceiling. On a lectern, open: the Ledger.
Rhea finds her own name. The ink has burned through the page.

records_office.speaker: Rhea
records_office.text: There's something here. Something of mine.
She touches the page, and remembers.
A boy with bandaged fists, giving her half his bread.
A tall man at the door, laughing at the rain.
A woman at the table. Her face won't come.

records_office.speaker: Quill
records_office.text: How touching. And how kind of you to come to me.

records_office.speaker: Quill
records_office.text: Magistrate Quill. People keep forgetting the title. Thanks to you.

records_office.speaker: Quill
records_office.text: His Majesty doesn't trouble himself with couriers. That's what I'm for.

records_office.speaker: Quill
records_office.text: Finish her page, he said, and they will remember me again.

records_office.speaker: Dov
records_office.text: You took our mother. You don't get her too.

records_office.speaker: Quill
records_office.text: I left her empty. Who fears an empty courier?

records_office.speaker: Quill
records_office.text: Last time she had a whole life to burn. Now she has one page. This will be easy.

archive_insight.speaker: Rhea
archive_insight.text: He pulled back inside that book... and we couldn't touch him.

archive_insight.speaker: Dov
archive_insight.text: Every blow we landed came back as his.

archive_insight.speaker: Rhea
archive_insight.text: Then we don't let him sit in there. Hit him until he staggers. Hard and fast.

archive_warn.speaker: Dov
archive_warn.text: He's pulling back into the Ledger. Break him before it closes!

archive_threat.speaker: Quill
archive_threat.text: This time you won't get away.

archive_threat.speaker: Dov
archive_threat.text: Faster than before. Rhea, he's charging it faster!

quill_rise.text: Quill crumples. Then the Ledger flips open on its own.

quill_rise.speaker: Quill
quill_rise.text: You don't close a Ledger. It closes you.
He rises. His wounds are ink, and the ink is flowing back.

recollection_cutin.speaker: Rhea
recollection_cutin.text: Look at it, Quill. Look at what you took.

keepsake_burn.speaker: Rhea
keepsake_burn.text: He's right. I can't beat him like this.
A Keepsake: a memory held back for the end. Rhea has one. The page.

keepsake_burn.speaker: Dov
keepsake_burn.text: Rhea, don't. You just got us back.

keepsake_burn.speaker: Rhea
keepsake_burn.text: I'm forgetting you again. But I'll remember you... again.
She burns it. Her Echo floods back, brighter than it has ever been.
Recollection: she can drag Quill into the memory as it burns.
The night he came for their mother.

ending.speaker: Quill
ending.text: No... They were going to remember me...
His face blurs. Even as she looks at him, Rhea can't hold on to it.
The Ledger lies open. Her page is ash.

ending.speaker: Rhea
ending.text: Your name is Dov. I know that much. I don't know why it hurts.

ending.speaker: Dov
ending.text: That's all right. I'll remember for both of us.
Nala presses against Rhea's leg. That, she still remembers.
Somewhere above the city, a silhouette watches from the broken tower.
